source: Wave 8 Step 1 (2026-06-03). wS is the canonical wrapped native gas token per Sonic Labs official docs (docs.soniclabs.com/sonic/build-on-sonic/contract-addresses). USDC is the Circle native USDC token on Sonic (issued via Circle CCTP). USDC.e is the bridged variant from Sonic's official docs token list — included as a candidate token; presence and depth to be verified by Step 4 discovery. Sonic is a STANDALONE L1 (Fantom successor), not OP-Stack — wS is NOT at the 0x4200... canonical address.

wS.note: Wrapped Sonic native gas token. Per docs.soniclabs.com canonical contract addresses page. Plays the role of WETH on other chains, but Sonic is standalone L1 so the address is Sonic-specific (not OP-Stack 0x4200... canonical).

USDC.note: Circle-issued native USDC on Sonic (via CCTP). Address > 0x039e (wS), so token1=USDC in wS/USDC pairs. priceMode='normal' (same pattern as Base, opposite of Optimism native USDC).

USDC.e.note: Bridged USDC variant on Sonic per docs.soniclabs.com. Candidate token; depth and active usage to be confirmed by Step 4 discovery. SushiSwap tutorials reference wS/USDC.e pools so this token likely has real trading activity.
